notes: NYC 501(c)(3) that finds foster and permanent homes for reptiles and (mostly black) cats. Listed by the NY Turtle & Tortoise Society as a turtle-accepting rescue - confirmed on its own site as a reptile + cat rescue. A rare in-city reptile-rehoming option alongside the turtle-focused groups. Confirm current reptile-intake capacity by email/DM before referral.
